previous_headings: Calculation of body condition indices
title: bodycon Quick Start Guide
text: Residual-based body condition indices widely used ecology, use critiqued. Concerns include statistical assumptions residual-based approaches (García-Berthou, 2001), sensitivity methodological choices (Schulte-Hostedde et al., 2005; Peig Green, 2009), appropriateness varies among taxa (Jakob et al., 1996; Băncilă et al., 2010; Labocha Hayes, 2012). scaled mass index (SMI) provides alternative approach estimating body condition developed Peig Green (2009). SMI estimates expected body mass standardised body size based scaling relationship body size mass. bodycon, SMI method estimates scaling exponent using standardised major axis (SMA) regression, robust SMI method estimates scaling exponent using robust SMA regression. SMI approach assumes allometric relationship body size mass, measurements log-transformed scaling relationship estimated.
